title: Learning Monge maps with constrained drifting models
summary: We study the estimation of optimal transport (OT) maps between an arbitrary source probability measure and a log-concave target probability measure. Our contributions are twofold. First, we propose a new evolution equation in the set of transport maps. It can be seen as the gradient flow of a lift of some user-chosen divergence (e.g., the KL divergence, or relative entropy) to the space of transport maps, constrained to the convex set of optimal transport maps. We prove the existence of long-time solutions to this flow as well as its convergence toward the OT map as time goes to infinity,…
